<thought>The mass spectrum indicates a neutral formula C10H13NO2. The 13C NMR shows a carbonyl (~166 ppm), six aromatic carbons (~129–132 ppm) and three aliphatic carbons consistent with an O‑CH₃ (≈52 ppm), N‑CH₃ (≈43 ppm) and a benzylic CH₂ (≈38 ppm). This pattern matches a phenyl‑CH₂‑C(=O)‑N(Me)OMe (Weinreb amide of phenylacetic acid). The corresponding SMILES is “c1ccccc1CC(=O)N(C)OC”.</thought>
<final_answer>c1ccccc1CC(=O)N(C)OC</final_answer>
